Here's how to use the Escali Primo Digital Scale correctly for the best results:Getting Started•Place it on a flat, stable surface — uneven counters can throw off readings•Always turn it on before placing anything on it so it zeros out properlyUsing the Tare Function (the most useful feature)•Place your bowl or container on the scale, then press Tare to zero it out•Add your ingredient — you'll see only the ingredient's weight, not the container's•Press Tare again between ingredients to reset — perfect for adding multiple items to one bowlGetting Accurate Readings•Place items in the center of the platform for the most accurate reading•The minimum weight is 1g — anything lighter won't register•Don't exceed the 11 lb (5 kg) max capacityUnit Switching•Cycle through grams, ounces, pounds, and milliliters using the unit button — handy when following recipes in different formatsMaintenance Tips•Never submerge it in water — wipe clean with a damp cloth only•Remove batteries if storing for a long period to prevent corrosionWould you like tips specific to baking, meal prep, or portion control? {} Best practices for baking with a scale How to measure liquids accurately Add mixing bowls to my cart Show me more kitchen essentials {} Your feedback has been submitted!
